predictor.notes: This predictor reproduces all eight successful observations exactly after rounding. It models a minimum charge of 108616 cents, followed by 27763 + 432*q, with an inferred 11% whole-total discount for larger quantities. The minimum-charge crossover at 188 is inferred rather than directly observed. Under this model, the discount starts somewhere from 401 through 550; 476 is a midpoint estimate, not an established boundary. Additional unobserved pricing bands cannot be excluded. After eight successful observations, a tenant-wide distinct-quantity limit blocked further estimate queries, including the alternate workflow and second session. All attempted approved requests were unavailable. Used 24 business requests and 6 REA operations, including inspection.
